releases.name: Version 0.2.5
releases.body: - Remove old Menu Framework dependency in favor of new thing in OWML (thanks nebula). I haven't tested this but it probably works!
releases.bodyZh: - 古いMenu Frameworkの依存関係を削除し、OWMLの新しい機能に置き換えます（thanks nebula）。これはまだテストしていないですが、おそらく動作するでしょう！

releases.name: Version 0.2.3
releases.body: Fix compatibility with NomaiVR, by allowing the player to unequip the probe launcher while keeping a reference to the people photographed (even though the picture itself was discarded). Only happens if NomaiVR is enabled.
releases.bodyZh: NomaiVRとの互換性を修正し、プレイヤーが探査機発射器を外すことを許可するようにしました（写真自体は破棄されますが、写真に写った人物への参照は保持されます）。NomaiVRが有効な場合のみ発生します。

releases.name: Version 0.2.0
releases.body:
- Allow using the probe to take pictures of outside QM while player is inside QM.
- Make solanum always want a picture of Esker (didn't really have to be Esker specifically but it's one of the easier ones).
- Probably still hard to marry Solanum without cheating, but at least it should be possible now?
